title: Zoho Books Pricing 2026: Plans, Tiers and Limits
summary: Zoho Books pricing spans six tiers from free to Ultimate. See the cost, feature limits and extra charges for each to pick the plan that suits your needs.
body_markdown:
## Why Zoho Books Costs More Than Quoted


Within two months, a ten-person firm that picks Zoho Books on the headline price **pays more than quoted** , because the caps on its tier arrive before the year does. The firm here is a composite, built to show the mechanics.


Not all ten people need the same access. Partners approve, two staff bill, a bookkeeper reconciles, and an outside accountant needs read access.


Each tier caps how many users and roles it includes, so the quoted price covers the people you have today, not the accountant you add in month two. Count roles, not headcount.


### Zoho Books Invoice, Contact and Automation Caps


Zoho meters invoices, and the allowance is annual. The free plan **allows 1,000 a year** , which is under 85 a month, so a firm billing retainers and project milestones can pass it by autumn.


5,000 invoices a year is what Standard allows, roughly 415 a month and comfortable for ten people. Professional allows 10,000, so moving up doubles your headroom and is worth paying for only if you actually bill above 5,000.


Step up to Premium and the allowance is 25,000, a jump of 2.5 times over Professional.


**Elite and Ultimate both allow 100,000** , so the step from Premium to Elite quadruples the cap, but it matters only to high-volume billers. A services firm rarely needs it.


Because the allowance resets annually, a spike in one quarter can force the upgrade even when your yearly average looks safe.


When that spike comes from orders and payments retyped by hand, Activepieces can take over the handoff by passing them into Zoho Books through its 746 integrations, so volume stops depending on someone's typing.


Its core is MIT-licensed, and the 746 is counted directly from the packages/integrations/community directory of the open-source monorepo on GitHub, which holds 25,329 stars, rather than quoted from a marketing page.


Expect approval workflows, custom roles and automation to come with higher tiers or cost extra as add-ons. The headline tier gets you the ledger, but the controls a growing team wants may need the next plan up.


Check the feature you need against the tier before you check the price.


### Currency, tax and regional price differences


The figure on the page you see may not match the one in your billing currency, because Zoho publishes prices by region. Zoho usually adds tax on top of the plan price, so a quote can rise before you use a single invoice.


Read the pricing page for your own country, and add tax to the total before comparing tiers.
